description: Top traders of one Robinhood Chain token, ranked by REALIZED ETH flow, enriched with wallet reputation (win_rate, likely_bot, is_known_kol, kol_name), dump-cluster membership and early-buyer rank. CRITICAL: net_eth is sell_eth MINUS buy_eth — realized flow, NOT PnL. It does not value a trader's remaining bag, so a wallet that bought and still holds ranks LAST, not first. Do not present net_eth as profit. For FIFO cost-basis PnL use the wallet PnL endpoint instead. Tier: PRO+ (50 rows; ULTRA/BUSINESS raises the cap to 200).
name: rhc_token_top_traders
